label: sec:particle-conjectures-intro
html:
Within the substrate consistency window around q_0 \approx 1.1100, the topological dictionary between prime links on the exceptional divisor and elementary Standard Model states imposes rigid structural constraints across three sectors:

  • Electroweak symmetry breaking and the Higgs sector: The torus link T(2,8) spanning three exceptional divisors encodes the Higgs scalar, fixing the electroweak vacuum expectation value v and the Higgs-to-Z mass ratio from the H_3(q) Wedderburn trace.
  • S_5-equivariant torus-knot embeddings: The automorphism group S_5 of Bring's genus-4 surface restricts equivariant torus-knot embeddings to the trefoil T_{2,3} and the cinquefoil T_{2,5}.
  • Lepton symmetry sorting: Charged leptons and neutrinos separate into symmetry-preserving and symmetry-broken generators according to their commutation with the residual cyclic subgroup C_5 \subset S_5.
